_comment: Coordinator cadence log. One JSON object per line, append-only, no wrapping array and no trailing commas. Fields: checked_at (ISO-8601 timestamp with local UTC offset), idle (number of subagents observed idle at that instant), running (number observed running at that instant), action (what the check did with the idle capacity). Keep this file small and hand-maintained; append one line per check and never edit or delete an earlier line. This log is discipline plus visibility, never a monitor: no CI job can detect an idle agent, because a GitHub-hosted runner holds no session wall-clock and sees only the commits and workflow events it is triggered by. So nothing here is enforced automatically, and a missing entry means the check did not run, not that nothing was idle. Counts are point-in-time observations of agent state and carry no meaning once the session that produced them has ended. This log is not a work queue, not an approval grant, and not a statement that any assigned work was completed; for authority read docs/approvals/APPROVAL_REGISTER.md, and for status read the owning backlog.

From 2026-10-01T20:22:51-07:00 through 2026-10-02T08:25:00-07:00 the coordinator recorded its cadence checks to session-local state instead of this tracked file, and session state does not survive a new chat; the coordinator's session record holds 49 checks over that window and reports 47 records lost, and neither figure is verifiable from this repository, which holds only the two entries above. The gap is a defect of the coordinator's process, not a window in which nothing ran: the checks did run, and only their records are missing, so the _comment rule that a missing entry means the check did not run does not describe this gap. No per-check record survives, and none is invented here. Recorded by the reconciliation pull request that added this line.

_cadence_rule: Appending each check to THIS tracked file is a required step of the cadence, performed at the moment of the check, not a convenience deferred to session state. This file is the record. A session log is not. A check that was not appended here cannot be told apart from one that did not run.

CADENCE STEP ADDED (PROC-08 durable remedy, 2026-10-03): at each cadence run ONE read-only detector over the RECENT REMOTE REFS - for each branch listed by `git ls-remote --heads origin`, fail when `gh pr list --head <branch> --state all` returns empty, i.e. work was pushed and never proposed (pushed != proposed). This is a LOCAL check, not a hosted workflow: a hosted runner has no `gh` authentication for this repository. The detector is COMPLETE over the refs it reads, because the branch itself is the readable artifact, so unlike PROC-07's silent dispatch an empty result here IS a real finding. It cannot be retrospective - it reports the state at the instant it runs, which is why the remedy is a cadence step and not a one-off sweep. Landed by the same change that records PROC-14 and the PROC-04 standards half in docs/evidence/documentation/process-issues-and-prevention-2026-10-02.md.
